lines.trans: Boss, you rest here for a bit. I will go get your medicine.
Director Chun, the backstage layout has been adjusted, the lounge is over here.
With such a huge drama happening over there, it would be strange if your stomach did not hurt.
Thank you for your hard work.
This is the second time I am seeing you. I caused you trouble.
Then if there is nothing else, I will go get busy.
